backend/main.mo: Defines order types and an actor with authorization, blob storage, and CRUD operations for creating, updating, and retrieving user‑owned orders with admin gating.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, associated files, components, tests, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file, covering pages, components, hooks, and UI behavior.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base and theme variable definitions for light/dark modes with custom color tokens and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/@types/html2canvas.d.ts: Type declaration stub for html2canvas with no content.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes, authentication gating, theme provider, and main application layout.
frontend/src/components/AdminGate.tsx: Admin‑only route guard that checks admin status and shows access denied UI when unauthorized.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Root layout component with disclaimer banner, header, content container, and footer.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Authentication gate that blocks unauthenticated users and provides an Internet Identity sign‑in prompt.
frontend/src/components/AuthStatusButton: Auth button handling Internet Identity login/logout and clearing React Query cache on sign‑out.
frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx: Renders the site header with navigation, admin link, and auth status based on user identity.
frontend/src/components/IdCardActions.ts: Provides buttons to export the ID card as PNG or print it, with success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/IdCardPreview.ts: Displays a styled ID card preview with user details, photo, seal, and watermark.
frontend/src/components/IdWatermark.tsx: Shows a red roleplay-only watermark overlay for ID cards.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCropModal.t: Modal for cropping an uploaded photo to ID aspect ratio using drag and zoom.
frontend/src/components/PhotoUploader.ts: Handles image upload via file selection or drag‑and‑drop, with validation and preview.
frontend/src/components/RoleplayDisclaim: Displays a top‑page banner warning that IDs are for roleplay only.
frontend/src/components/StateSeal.tsx: Renders a state seal image or a fallback icon if no seal is available.
frontend/src/constants/usStates.ts: Exports a list of U.S. states with codes and names.
frontend/src/content/copy.ts: Provides reusable text constants for disclaimers and UI copy.
frontend/src/hooks/auth/useIsAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks if the current actor is an admin.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/queryKeys.ts: Defines React Query keys for order and auth queries.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useAllOrders.t: Fetches all orders for admin users via the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useCreateOrder: Mutation for creating a new order and invalidating user order queries.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useGetOrder.ts: Fetches a single order by ID using the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useUpdateOrder: Mutation for updating an order's status and refreshing related queries.
Fetches orders belonging to the current user.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on the current identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth state, login/logout functions, and initializes AuthClient with stored or newly authenticated identities.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theme variables, animations, and print rules for consistent UI styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Displays all orders for admins with status controls and live updates using backend mutations.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Shows a user's orders with status badges and navigation to create or view individual orders.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Presents the marketing landing page with a hero section, flow overview, and navigation into the app.
frontend/src/pages/NewOrderPage.tsx: Form page for creating a new roleplay ID order with photo upload, cropping, validation, and submission to backend.
frontend/src/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single order, including status, ID preview, and roleplay disclaimers.
frontend/src/utils/exportIdCard.ts: Exports the ID card preview as a PNG using an SVG foreignObject fallback and provides a print fallback.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Contains simple string formatters, including capitalizing order status values.
frontend/src/utils/stateSeals.ts: Resolves the file path for a state's seal image based on the US_STATES list.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, animations, layouts, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing scope, features, requirements, theme, and current implementation state for the roleplay ID system.
